title: Akupanel |  Acoustic Panel / Natural Wood, Rustic Grey Oak, Black Felt, 240 x 60 cm
description: The Natural Wood Akupanel is a slatted wall panel that reduces echo and adds warmth to any room. Real wood veneer on every slat — handpicked, so no two panels look alike. Works on walls and ceilings, pairs with Create accessories. Rooted in Scandinavian design principles — natural materials and calm environments working together.
